hero.title:
Every card,

right where it belongs.
hero.subtitle: Load your cards into the hopper and Mault takes it from there. The feeder pushes each one past the camera to be recognized, then sorts it into bins using rules you set: rarity, color, set, type, or anything else. No spreadsheets, no guesswork.

supportedGames.heading: Easily sorts any TCG you love

features.heading: Everything you need to feel organized
features.subtitle: Let Mault handle the sorting, so you can spend more time playing and less time digging through boxes.

recognition.title: Instant recognition
recognition.description: No typing card names, no barcodes. The feeder puts each card in front of the camera, and Mault knows exactly what it is.

rules.title: Rules you control
rules.description: Mix and match conditions, rarity, color, set, type, and more, to send every card exactly where you'd like.

autoAssign.title: Auto bin assignment
autoAssign.description: Skip the rule-writing. Pick a field like rarity or set, and the first card with a new value claims the next open bin. Repeats route back automatically.

repack.title: Build repacks
repack.description: Define pack slots per bin, like 3 commons and 1 rare, and every bin fills its own pack at the same time. Empty it to start the next one.

alphabet.title: Alphabetical sorting
alphabet.description: Sort a pile A to Z, one letter per bin. Then drill into any pile, A into AA, AB, AC, until every card is in order.

sounds.title: Custom sounds
sounds.description: Upload your own clips and play them when a matching card is sorted, like a fanfare for every mythic or a cha-ching for anything over $20.

collections.title: Multiple collections
collections.description: Keep separate collections for trade binders, decks, or storage boxes, and hop between them whenever you like.

insights.title: Know what you own
insights.description: See counts, rarities, and sets across your whole library, so you never have to guess what's in the box.

logging.title: Every card logged
logging.description: Every scan is saved automatically, so your collection stays accurate without any extra bookkeeping.

hardware.title: Built for the table
hardware.description: Pairs with a physical sorter, so your cards land in real bins, not just another spreadsheet. Add more sorting modules any time to grow up to 11 bins.

openSource.heading: Fully open source
openSource.subtitle: The software and the physical sorter are both free to build, inspect, and tinker with. Grab the code and print one of your own.

sourceCode.title: Source code
sourceCode.description: The web app, API, and sorter firmware all live together in one repo, under an open license.

printableSorter.title: 3D printable sorter
printableSorter.description: Print your own card sorter at home. Fusion 360 and 3MF files are right there in the repo.

community.title: Community
community.description: Join the Discord to share your build, get a hand when you need it, and chat with others running their own sorter.

pricing.heading: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: The same app either way. Free covers casual sorting. Business removes the daily scan cap, runs several sorters at once, and unlocks unlimited custom sounds and Discord notification rules.
